spanish: Esto darán todo el pasante sobre los contados: mitad del siclo en siclo de la santidad; veinte gera el siclo; mitad del siclo ofrenda a Jehová.

findings.issue: el pasante, in current Latin American Spanish, names an intern; the token is a definite qal active participle of passing, so the passing participant is omitted and an unlicensed role is added
los contados locks the numbering sense of a polysemous passive participle (number, muster, appoint, visit)

notes: The other tokens, the repeated mitad del siclo, the verbless measure, and Jehová stay within the packet.
